required_facts: Live keyword, product destination, availability and purchase evidence.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.

scenario_settings.inheritance: Observed account opt-out, menu and global exclusions apply separately. These are not template defaults. No account setting changed.

rules.refusal: Source stop, negative-answer, no-response and expiry ports are retained. Account opt-out is a separate inherited control.
rules.reentry: Per-template Limit frequency per contact defaults and shared enabled options are preserved in scenario settings.
rules.duplicates: No idempotency guarantee established. Frequency control is not proof of cross-scenario deduplication.
rules.failure_semantics: UI retry/expiry values are preserved per node. Transport/runtime failures were not tested; lack of runtime proof is not counted as an unopened setting.
